title: Report asset files
responsibility: Checks evidence signatures, stores content-addressed assets and resolves registered local files.

inputs.name: reportAssets.directory
inputs.description: Destination report directory used to store the imported file beneath an assets subdirectory. The helper creates that subdirectory recursively.

inputs.name: reportAssets.source
inputs.description: Filesystem path inspected as the evidence source; symbolic links, non-files, and files larger than 50,000,000 bytes are rejected. Its detected media type selects the audio or image handling path.

inputs.name: imageAsset.bytes
inputs.description: Nonempty image bytes in a Buffer no larger than 50,000,000 bytes. Signature checks recognize PNG, JPEG, and WebP headers but do not decode the full image.

inputs.name: imageAsset.filename
inputs.description: Image filename whose lowercased extension must be .png, .jpg, .jpeg, or .webp and agree with the detected signature. A JPEG named .jpeg is returned with a .jpg extension.

inputs.name: writeImageAsset.directory
inputs.description: Destination report directory; the helper writes under its assets subdirectory and creates that directory recursively.

inputs.name: writeImageAsset.name
inputs.description: Filename joined beneath the assets subdirectory for the write. The helper does not validate or sanitize this string.

inputs.name: writeImageAsset.bytes
inputs.description: Buffer written as supplied, without size, signature, or content validation. The file is created with mode 0600.

inputs.name: registeredAsset.directory
inputs.description: Directory canonicalized with realpath to establish the boundary for resolving an asset name. Filesystem lookup failures reject the promise.

inputs.name: registeredAsset.name
inputs.description: Requested filename that must exactly occur in registered and contain neither a slash nor a backslash. The joined path must resolve to a regular non-symlink file inside the canonical directory.

inputs.name: registeredAsset.registered
inputs.description: Caller-provided list of allowed filenames; membership is checked by exact string equality before path resolution.

outputs.name: imageAsset
outputs.description: Object containing the SHA-256 digest of the bytes plus their detected extension and the corresponding MIME type. Detection checks PNG, JPEG, and WebP signatures without fully decoding the image.

outputs.name: writeImageAsset
outputs.description: Promise resolving to undefined after creating the assets directory recursively with mode 0700 and writing the supplied bytes with creation mode 0600.

outputs.name: reportAssets
outputs.description: Promise resolving to metadata for the stored audio or image asset after source checks and a content-addressed write under directory/assets. The image branch returns name, mediaType, and mimeType; audio metadata comes from audioAsset.

outputs.name: registeredAsset
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the canonical-base path for the requested registered file after confirming it is a regular non-symlink file whose real path remains inside the base directory.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Validation failures are thrown as Error, including invalid source files, image content, and registered paths. Filesystem and delegated audio-validation failures also reject through the calling promise.

inputs.name: reportAssets.directory
inputs.description: Destination report directory used to store the imported file beneath an assets subdirectory. The helper creates that subdirectory recursively.

inputs.name: reportAssets.source
inputs.description: Filesystem path inspected as the evidence source; symbolic links, non-files, and files larger than 50,000,000 bytes are rejected. Its detected media type selects the audio or image handling path.

outputs.name: reportAssets
outputs.description: Promise resolving to metadata for the stored audio or image asset after source checks and a content-addressed write under directory/assets. The image branch returns name, mediaType, and mimeType; audio metadata comes from audioAsset.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when the source is a symlink, is not a file, or exceeds 50,000,000 bytes; media-specific validation and filesystem failures also reject the promise.

inputs.name: imageAsset.bytes
inputs.description: Nonempty image bytes in a Buffer no larger than 50,000,000 bytes. Signature checks recognize PNG, JPEG, and WebP headers but do not decode the full image.

inputs.name: imageAsset.filename
inputs.description: Image filename whose lowercased extension must be .png, .jpg, .jpeg, or .webp and agree with the detected signature. A JPEG named .jpeg is returned with a .jpg extension.

outputs.name: imageAsset
outputs.description: Object containing the SHA-256 digest of the bytes plus their detected extension and the corresponding MIME type. Detection checks PNG, JPEG, and WebP signatures without fully decoding the image.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when bytes are empty or exceed 50,000,000 bytes, the extension is unsupported, no supported signature is found, or the filename extension disagrees with the detected signature.

inputs.name: writeImageAsset.directory
inputs.description: Destination report directory; the helper writes under its assets subdirectory and creates that directory recursively.

inputs.name: writeImageAsset.name
inputs.description: Filename joined beneath the assets subdirectory for the write. The helper does not validate or sanitize this string.

inputs.name: writeImageAsset.bytes
inputs.description: Buffer written as supplied, without size, signature, or content validation. The file is created with mode 0600.

outputs.name: writeImageAsset
outputs.description: Promise resolving to undefined after creating the assets directory recursively with mode 0700 and writing the supplied bytes with creation mode 0600.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects when creating the assets directory or writing the file fails; this helper performs no content validation.

inputs.name: registeredAsset.directory
inputs.description: Directory canonicalized with realpath to establish the boundary for resolving an asset name. Filesystem lookup failures reject the promise.

inputs.name: registeredAsset.name
inputs.description: Requested filename that must exactly occur in registered and contain neither a slash nor a backslash. The joined path must resolve to a regular non-symlink file inside the canonical directory.

inputs.name: registeredAsset.registered
inputs.description: Caller-provided list of allowed filenames; membership is checked by exact string equality before path resolution.

outputs.name: registeredAsset
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the canonical-base path for the requested registered file after confirming it is a regular non-symlink file whose real path remains inside the base directory.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws for unregistered names, names containing a slash or backslash, symlinks, non-files, or paths outside the canonical directory; filesystem lookup failures also reject.
